name: Raspberry Pi + ADC (built-in)
description: PCB TestKit's own tester: the fixture gets a generated 2 x N header (GND, then one pin per measured net) and a power terminal; the runner reads ADS1115 / MCP3008 ADCs or an MCU over serial and switches the board's supply with a GPIO. Channel count and input range follow testplan.max_channels and testplan.adc_max_v.
